pages.meta_description: Global Group of Education provides the finest consultants to help you achieve your desired degree from one of the best institutes in the UK and the world ranked universities.
content: In this era of educational competition, the Global Group of Education brings you the finest consultants to help you achieve your desired degree from one of the best institutes in the UK and the world top-ranked universities. Our consultants are co-operative and excel at their work.

We have trustworthy consultant’s veterans who are highly qualified and are skilled at their work. Our expert team that will guide you according to your preference and potential, and will also provide you with impartial advice.

We have a mission of making international education accessible and providing students with opportunities that will lead them towards a successful career. We are reliable, co-operative and have a fantastic team working to make education even more convenient.
We will be with you throughout your journey from course selection to your degree completion. For us, your comfort and preference is our utmost priority.

No need to panic if you’re in the situation you can’t comprehend. If you’re facing even a slight of confusion regarding your studies, you can contact us on our given contact details. Our co-operative consultants will guide you thoroughly.

To bring for you multiple choices, we have lengthened our threads to various high-ranked institutes. We have a connection web spread throughout many universities so that we can provide you with the best quality education and course of your choice.
We have turned the dreams of thousands of students into reality with our brilliant services and excellent team, and are looking forward to making your dreams come true as well.
Take a tour GGE Know more

“The main reason behind creating this platform is to provide such opportunities for students who are ambiguous about what they want to study, help them find the right path to channel their potential and work their way out into a successful career. We have a reputable and highly-trained team which will be by your side throughout your whole stay and will guide you in accordance with your preferences. We know that you might confront doubt when applying for international studies, but we ensure that the security of your future will never be compromised.”

content: Global Group of education helps you get admission in your preferred university. Global Group of education Assistance offers you the latest study advice for studying abroad. As consultants, our services begin when you contact us for our services. To align you with the university and course that suits your career goals, we offer free study counselling services. Our experts advise on scholarship opportunities and provide advice on visas.
We have brought for you a consultant company in which we provide you with a strategy that will work the best for your successful future. We assist you in every way possible in every step.

STUDENT PROFILING At Global Group of Education, we understand that qualifying for universities abroad is not just about filling out a request form. The first step that goes in it is reviewing the student form critically and devise a plan according to it.

DOCUMENT VERIFICATION Our Global Group of Education student advisors offers document verification service as part of the admission process for the students. We will provide guidance about different universities document requirement.

APPLICATION SUBMISSION Global Group of Education consultants are highly qualified to highlight any gaps in the application and smooth out the application process. Our advisor will keep you up-to-date at every point, and that's how you end up securing a position in your desired university.

INTERVIEW PREPARATION Our experts at Global Group of Education have educated thousands of students through mock interviews. Years of experience have helped us recognise interview questions and direct you on how best to respond.

We recognise that you want to study at the best institution possible, and our multi-lingual consultants studying abroad provide advisory services will make it possible. They have received recognised and certified training and are also a UCAS (Universities and College Admissions Service) accredited centre, where you can be confident that experts are checking your application.

Highly experienced Global group of education consultants provide pre-departure preparation and assistance to international students across multiple subjects. This enables any student at an overseas university to adapt and adjust to their surroundings easily. We ensure the event is highly collaborative with industry experts sharing their feedback based on real-life experiences objectively. All our workers come with overseas experience from first hand. They offer essential information to international students that should be carefully noted in order to prevent any problems during your overseas transit. The global group of education’s pre-departure preparation is important for learners to understand better what to expect when they land to a foreign land.

pages.title: Why Global Group of Education
pages.meta_description: Why Global Group of Education

h3: Why choose Global Group of Education?
WE ARE HERE FOR YOU TO DIRECT YOU ON THE RIGHT PATH

content: We provide students with the best guidance, package, assistance, course and university counselling which ensures a successful future for them.

We have our threads spread to various institutes and companies who encourage students to join them on their adventure. They serve as host for the international students. We have our best team with years of experience, excellence and intelligence for you so that you find what’s perfect for you. We teach and train you efficiently, and take multiple tests in order to find your true level of potential for further guidance. We don’t just assume but calculate on every minute detail and don’t leave any loose ends.

Our consultants are available for you not only before your admissions but till the day you get your degree. We help you in every possible way. If you happen to face any confusion or issue at any state of time during your stay, we have our team with whom you can contact. We provide counselling not only to the students but to parents as well for better understanding of the whole package. Furthermore, we have no hidden charges; rather, we display you the schedule and plan for your applicant as well as the entire fee structure.
Students get admitted to foreign institutes for various reasons that may be the merit, scholarship, needs, career or some other reasons. For this, we are here to tell you about all the opportunities.

Our efficient and friendly consultants will be with you whenever you need them starting from a mere discussion over what to choose through the day to leading a successful career. You can call us anytime you feel like needing help, and we won’t leave you hanging.
We are easily reachable and easy to talk to, as our consultants have a huge amount of experience. We take down all the obstacles making your way to us smooth and fast.
We not only have a brilliant team, but we also tackle things professionally and quickly. We make sure that there is no hindrance in your way.
You will experience a whole new world out there with various languages, cultures, personalities, lands, places, and much more. And this exploration will lead you to self-exploration

content: Scholarships and financial support 7

If you have all the verifications done, all the documents sorted, filled in accurately every information asked and also have filled in other forms correctly like scholarship forms etc., then it is not hard to get the visa but all of this takes time in processing and this should be done months before the application date.
Students might need financial support while studying in another state. By applying for the financial aid, one can lessen the financial overload through it.
Every university has their own eligibility criteria through which they judge the application of the students. The basics include your test results, visa, qualification and grades etc.

Well, every university has about two intakes usually which are the spring ones and the fall ones but some universities might intake students more than twice. Students should just research beforehand about the universities and their intake routine so that they don’t miss the chance.

Studying abroad isn’t an easy decision as it consumes a lot of time, energy, money, as well as it requires support from family and your own psychological support. It takes courage to go to a whole new place with different people and environment, even the language might also be different. Not all courses and programs are same in various institutes and for that, we have our excellent counsellors to guide you.

We are a team which manages and guide you towards your journey with the help of our brilliant counsellors. We stick by the students from the first step till it graduates or complete the journey in the foreign place. We assist in every way possible be it financial issue, scholarship, tests, residential issue etc. we will guide you properly with the details about what every decision will do and what will be the circumstances. we provide support through the counsellors just a click away and they will help you whenever you need them. We not only provide counselling to the students but to the parents as well. We plan a strategy according to the student’s wishes and financial stability. Through our far spread web, we also help the student get internship or job according to the program and profile. So that the students studies and then pursue a successful career comfortably.

During the programme, students are allowed to work in part-time or full-time in a placement compulsory to attempt for the course, those specific programmes are called sandwich programmes. This placement also extends the time period of the programme by a few months to one year, depending upon the course and placement months.

Concessions and Scholarships are offered by various universities. These are in the most basic form financial aid. Some universities also offer a job on campus so that the students can earn money and support itself.

If someone doesn’t have the required qualification then it can apply for the foundation course which is for one year. If someone has the work experience but not the qualification then, that student can apply for the post-graduate certificate program, claim the post-graduate degree then go for further programs.
The documents or forms asked by the university is the application package. It usually consists of letter of recommendation, transcripts, certificates, and other essential information.

Most of the times, the students willing to go out for further studies already have a plan in their mind about the even institute. But there are times when the student isn’t clear about the program they want to choose and that’s where we come in and help you with it.
These are one year programmes especially for the students who wants to connect between their qualifications. This is also done prior to apply for an international degree programme.
It will very convenient if you ask your counsellor about the form and about how to fill the form. Students should be very careful while filling in the form.

We at Global Group of Education will provide the students with forms and students will have to fill in all the required information and apply according to the date keeping in mind that things like that take time to process.
There is probability that you get admission in a university. Get in touch with our counsellors to guide you further in such circumstances.

Different universities have different dates and the students who wish to study overseas must gather the information about all the deadlines or programmes dates. Keeping in mind the information before is better.

It’s just like getting admission in any university but requires processing time and certain tests, training etc. it differs in all institutes. Basics are the tests, your major, your scores etc. you should have your previous degree before applying for further degree. If you already have qualification required for the particular programme you want to go in then come to us and we’ll guide you accordingly.

Through sandwich programmes you get the first-hand experience during your studies and also before the completion of the degree, in an industry or organisation relating to your field and career what could be better than this. This not only helps you gain the experience, but also helps improve your grades and is very helpful in getting a job after the graduation.

There aren’t any specific numerals to inform the students about. The students can show up with the least sum of money, maybe equivalent to the tuition fee. In case of ambiguity, you may also consult with our counsellors.

Teaching Assistantship is about assisting the teacher in multiple ways which might include test checking and the student might be asked to teach as well. Through this way, a student can earn money and it will be able to pay his/her dues.

Sometimes the student wishes to choose a particular degree which might not go with the profile of the student and that’s why it might get rejected. There’s no need to worry. Our counsellors will find the right course for you in which you not only will be selected but also will succeed.

The duration mostly depends on the degree or program you choose. There are various short courses available that have short period of time. A graduate program degree will take minimum of four years whereas undergraduate program takes at least three years.

It usually depends upon the universities rules and policies but most of the students do change their major during their programme. Majority of the students tend to change it in their four year programme according to the policies of the institute.

It is okay to be anxious or confused when someone talks about interview. The interview panel is, most of the time, co-operative but to be properly prepared for this and for the online video interview with the UK panel, our counsellors will be here. They will guide you thoroughly.

In this assistantship, the student will be under the assistant of the professor and will have to be a part of a research project. Through this, the university will decrease the fees partially or maybe completely. The student will only have to pay the other dues.
Every student who decides to study abroad further has some ambitions in mind or the career they want to choose or course. And we will help you make the decision.

That mostly depends upon the course you’re studying, whether it’s short-term course or a long-term course. The work hours are adjusted according to your schedule. During the week-days, the student can work for less hours and then at weekends it can work for the whole day. A lot of jobs are offered on per hour and not on monthly basis. If you’re not able to find any suitable job for yourself then you may also consult the job agency to provide you with the best suitable job for you.

There are terms and conditions on the student visa and according to some, if the student gets the a job after completing the programme which fits the criteria required, then the visa might be extended. However, in some circumstances, if the student start their own business, they can also get the extension.

Majorly the scholarships and other awards are based on merit and academic evaluation. However, there are some universities who award scholarship based on an essay they ask the willing students to write on.
It differs between the universities what they require but the basic are as follows:

It depends upon the circumstances and policy of the institute and country. Most of them allow the students to stay and look for the job according to their course major. Majority of the students get the job at the same place they did their internship or placement year during the degree.
Some departments work fast whereas some departments take time in processing and verification. It is hard to provide with a specific period.

Scholarships are not only awarded by the universities but also by the government and private sectors. The student must search for the eligibility criteria for all the scholarships in its desired course. The research might take more time, so this should be done beforehand.
Almost every university has their career counselling and support centre, you may discuss it with them about your plans. Also seek help from your teacher as well. They might help you with that too.

You can always apply for the visa again after acknowledging the cause behind the rejection and correcting it this time. As every institute has their own terms and conditions, therefore, some universities refund you with your money and some might not. Also the visa fees is not refundable. But no need to worry, as our counsellors will inform you about every circumstance.

Scholarships and financial support 7

If you have all the verifications done, all the documents sorted, filled in accurately every information asked and also have filled in other forms correctly like scholarship forms etc., then it is not hard to get the visa but all of this takes time in processing and this should be done months before the application date.

Students might need financial support while studying in another state. By applying for the financial aid, one can lessen the financial overload through it.

Every university has their own eligibility criteria through which they judge the application of the students. The basics include your test results, visa, qualification and grades etc.

Well, every university has about two intakes usually which are the spring ones and the fall ones but some universities might intake students more than twice. Students should just research beforehand about the universities and their intake routine so that they don’t miss the chance.

Studying abroad isn’t an easy decision as it consumes a lot of time, energy, money, as well as it requires support from family and your own psychological support. It takes courage to go to a whole new place with different people and environment, even the language might also be different. Not all courses and programs are same in various institutes and for that, we have our excellent counsellors to guide you.

We are a team which manages and guide you towards your journey with the help of our brilliant counsellors. We stick by the students from the first step till it graduates or complete the journey in the foreign place. We assist in every way possible be it financial issue, scholarship, tests, residential issue etc. we will guide you properly with the details about what every decision will do and what will be the circumstances. we provide support through the counsellors just a click away and they will help you whenever you need them. We not only provide counselling to the students but to the parents as well. We plan a strategy according to the student’s wishes and financial stability. Through our far spread web, we also help the student get internship or job according to the program and profile. So that the students studies and then pursue a successful career comfortably.

During the programme, students are allowed to work in part-time or full-time in a placement compulsory to attempt for the course, those specific programmes are called sandwich programmes. This placement also extends the time period of the programme by a few months to one year, depending upon the course and placement months.

Concessions and Scholarships are offered by various universities. These are in the most basic form financial aid. Some universities also offer a job on campus so that the students can earn money and support itself.

If someone doesn’t have the required qualification then it can apply for the foundation course which is for one year. If someone has the work experience but not the qualification then, that student can apply for the post-graduate certificate program, claim the post-graduate degree then go for further programs.

The documents or forms asked by the university is the application package. It usually consists of letter of recommendation, transcripts, certificates, and other essential information.

Most of the times, the students willing to go out for further studies already have a plan in their mind about the even institute. But there are times when the student isn’t clear about the program they want to choose and that’s where we come in and help you with it.

These are one year programmes especially for the students who wants to connect between their qualifications. This is also done prior to apply for an international degree programme.

It will very convenient if you ask your counsellor about the form and about how to fill the form. Students should be very careful while filling in the form.

We at Global Group of Education will provide the students with forms and students will have to fill in all the required information and apply according to the date keeping in mind that things like that take time to process.

h3: Points to keep in sight while studying abroad

content: Going to a foreign land can be a bit confusing as well as exciting. Adapting to a new environment can be challenging, and these are times like these when you seek help, and that is where we come in. During your stay, our team will be in contact with you and will be provided with all the information needed.
One thing you should keep in mind while going to a new place is

communication in different language. If it’s a language that you’re already familiar with, then it’s good to go, but chances of the opposite are most likely to occur as well. One should keep in view the details of the course and whether or not they require some additional language to be learned or your native language is enough. In that case, you might want to choose a language course as well so that you can understand better and learn more.

Our classes will also provide you with information about the country/city you’re going to and will assist you in learning. Before sending you to your desired location for studies, we will tell you all about the place, its culture, its standard of living, its routine, and the life of the people there and how you can adjust easily, without facing difficulties.

All information will be provided to you beforehand. Date and time of your departure along with the residential information will be in accordance with your selected course and institute. Some institutes don’t have a residential facility for students, and in that case, we will arrange a place for you to stay. Our students are our top priority and we will make sure that you do not have any issue or doubt left, if there’s any, we will take care of it. We also arrange an orientation in which you will have a better understanding of the whole plan.
Students who study abroad belong to different categories, some study on scholarships, some have other bases like careers, needs, merits etc.

It is always better to think ahead and plan everything. Avoid the last-minute struggle of studying and draw out a time table for your studies. Plan everything before and create a balance between studies and fun.

Sometimes you overstep in spending while living in a foreign place which might cause financial problems. To avoid that, keep your mind from straying away. Create a bank account and save as much as you can. Travel in buses, do not spend on extra shopping, buy the necessities only.
Keep everything organized to avoid the fuss. Don’t overload yourself with extra luggage, stay light. Keep all your documents and pass them in one place. Don’t forget to carry other essentials.
Connect with people around you, at your institute, at your workplace. Meet professors, attend workshops and multiple lectures. Join different communities, learn more and stay connected.

It is not wise to lock yourself in a room to avoid contact. Go out and meet people. People from different backgrounds and jobs. Obtain as much knowledge as you can by socializing. Avoid outside food and try to maintain a healthy lifestyle.

It is beneficial for you if you start earning or learning during your course period. Extra skills always come in hand. You might seek a part-time job opportunity, an internship, or some other skills or course which will help you in your career.

content:

Scholarships And Funding
UNITED KINGDOM Visa Guidance

The United Kingdom is one place which is famous for a lot of things, great monuments and holds historical importance as well. One of the major reasons for its fame is the education standard and institutes. Half of the high-ranked universities are in the UK and for which it is a source of attraction for millions of students.

Students from all over the world choose to study in the UK as it is preferred for education worldwide. Every year, more than 400,000 come to the UK for education purposes. Because of the scholarships offered, the structure, the advantages, high-quality education and much more are the main reasons that there’s a prominent increment in the number of students applying and studying in the UK.

Adaptation of multiple cultures can also be seen in the UK. There are various colonies, streets and markets influenced by a particular culture in which they have everything. The UK is unique in a way that it can absorb multiple traditions and customs, blending them well enough within itself. Even though the lifestyle differs as per individual but they all have respect for each other and greet with a smile.

As the UK is already an amalgam of various well-known countries and easily blends in a different culture, there’s a wide range of cuisines from around the world. They Asian, Mexican, Continental, Seafood, Indian, etc. Also, the costs vary from place to place and the type of food. There’s a whole variety in restaurants, cafes that offer vegan and non-vegan, and even food streets have that option.

pages.title: Scholarship advice
pages.meta_description: Scholarship advice
content: International scholarships are given on the bases of qualifications, needs, occupations, career, and universities. Talk with Global Group of Education counsellors to know more about international scholarships for both undergraduate studies and postgraduate studies abroad.

Relief is offered on a merit-based basis, a scheme that began to evolve primarily as top tier colleges competing for the brightest and most eligible candidates. According to the famous words of Troy Miller, prizes are awarded for outstanding students, based on their accomplishments in academics, athletics, and even extra-curricular programmes.

Universities also offer financial assistance in developing talent, to tackle the supply of shortages and predict the predictable long-term advantages of halting employment. It helps workers who frequently face a labour-deficit to perform a number of professional tasks. Students who seek jobs in expertise shortages domains will obtain significant financial assistance. Awarded predecessor to numerous factors like academic accomplishments, personal achievements, volunteer activities, overall profiles and more, these scholarship opportunities are intensely competitive and usually in the form of reduced tuition fees.

Financial support is one of the main requirements for which students are eligible for a scholarship. Financially less fortunate classes of students earn supports by taking their academic performance into account. However, the decision-making by itself depends on the monetary stability of the families of the students. When you register with Global Group of Education, get financial aid for your tuition expenses, living costs, either entirely or partly with study abroad scholarships.

When awarding scholarships, the students and their distinctive characteristics are considered. It may be due to medical conditions, age, gender or some other factors that differentiate them. Also known as minority-based scholarships, those benefits are intended to target groups that are at some level deprived of the basic requirement. It is a way of giving them opportunities with financial help to bring them on common grounds.

pages.meta_description: We, Global Group of Education, will train and teach you with all that you need to get started on this new journey.
content: Our experts at the Global Group of Education will equip you with how to negotiate a fair pay package through the job dilemma. Our research counsellors came with deep knowledge of the business and the industry. Talk to them over the phone or even chat online to receive detailed job advice to study abroad and ease your entire career path.

If you chose to study and work during your stay in an international land, you are taking one of the most important decisions of your life. Global Group of Education offers solid assistance to those who wish to go down this path. We will direct you to the right career opportunity based on your interest. From finding the most appropriate place to study to continuing your education, we will also provide you with a forum to pursue a career. We provide full visa assistance and exam preparation for

TOEFL, GRE, IELTS and other standardized exams. You can also get the best loan and scholarship opportunities and will also assist you with the onboarding and housing facilities. Global Group of Education addresses all the questions and concerns relating to your professions. Our comprehensive international study and career counselling services will offer you with versatile, affordable, and reliable job advice and plans that are customized to your needs.

Once you’ve decided to study abroad, you must be open to any possibility. Make sure you get all the training and counseling sessions, if needed, more consultations until you decide which course to study, which country to go and further details as well. It is of utmost importance that you choose according to your skills, abilities and interests because that will define the career you’ll heading towards in the future, so keep your goals and ambitions very clear. What you choose now will not only define your career but also who you are. Think very carefully and if confused then we’ll help you out. Think of a career which is practical and which will go a long way. Some careers require investment before the outcome and you should have financial support for that too. If you choose a career like that and then when the time comes and you can’t invest into your career, then it’s over.

Apart from counselling and 24/7 help, we also suggest you go through a series of tests that will lead us to a better understanding of you and your priorities. This might also help you get rid of confusion or ambiguity in mind. This will also help you and us decide what is better for you keeping in mind all the perspectives.

pages.title: Guide for Parents | Global Group of Education
pages.meta_description: Global Group of Education provides counselling for parents so they can achieve the peace of mind while their kids are getting the best education.
content: Letting your students go to a completely foreign place alone can cause fear in most of the parents. It’s absolutely normal for parents to worry about the security and health of their students regarding the new place.

Studying overseas can unlock many doors for students. They get new exposure, new experiences, high-quality education and endless opportunities to make their future. It is very much important for parents to be supportive of their child’s decision and encourage them to work hard.

Family plays a very prominent role in building a child’s future. If the parents are supportive, friendly and trusting, the child will automatically open up to his parents about his personal life and if the parents are extremely strict and don’t support their children, it might affect him psychologically which will influence his studies.
It is very important for children to stay psychologically stress-free in order to work properly.

It’s not easy to let go of your child. Global Group of Education not only thinks about the student’s comfort but also about his parents. We talk to the parents before they decide anything. We make sure that students, as well as their parents, are completely satisfied.

Also, we make everything very clear to the parents about the costs of residence, university fee and other expenses. Studying in a foreign place might cost you much more than here but the quality and exposure the students get in an overseas institute might never get it here.

We also teach the students about the local laws and other rules about the particular place they will be living in. This will give them a better understanding of the environment and also they’ll be able to speak up or act according to any situation. We will inform them about the pros and cons of a certain action or circumstance, so that they’re able to decide better for themselves.

We understand that there are some students who have health problems, some allergies or some other noticeable conditions. That’s why we ask the families to make a list of the medicines or other health care products that are needed for the students to make sure the availability of those medicines in its new residential area.

We then make preparations if they are not available and inform about the other medicines of the same formula for the students and get it checked by professionals. We also provide the students contacts in case of any emergency and get them vaccinated for ordinary diseases.
We work for you and if there are any queries, parents and students can contact our trustworthy consultants that will provide you with all the details and the whole structure till you feel contented.

pages.title: Student’s Intake | Global Group of Education
pages.meta_description: Come to us, and we will set you off to your educational journey in very next intake in the institute, and you won’t have to wait for a whole year.

h3: Be very clear about your choice
It is always good to prepare

content: It might happen that you have missed the deadline of submitting the form and fear of losing the chance of admission for a whole year. With us by your side, you won’t be able to miss out on the dates.

Almost all of the institutes have intakes three to four times a year. That’s why there’s no need to worry about admission. Maybe you wanted to study abroad and planned everything but didn’t about the dates in student intake; there’s no reason to stress upon. Come to us, and we will set you off to your educational journey in very next intake in the institute, eradicating the chances of missing a year.

Then some intakes only take place in some universities and some specific subjects. These are the ones that are in the mid of the year. A person cannot just decide, choose the courses and go to university. You must ensure all the requirements and verifications are complete and done. You don’t want to leave any loose ends for which we prefer and always recommend to start the training as well as the preparation 6-9 months before your departure.
Applications take time to process and we better plan our strategy keeping in sight the deadline.

Be very careful while filling your forms, especially the ones which are provided by the institute because that’s your first step to being accepted. Reread the form to avoid mistakes or misinterpretations recheck every minute detail before sending it to them.

There are some institutes who ask other questions as well to get a better understanding of the student they’ll be accepting. Be very clear about yourself and about the choice you’ve made regarding the specific course, institute, city etc. and also why you chose to study in a foreign place rather than your own.

You don’t want to forget your documents from the last university or institute you attended, like your extra-curricular certificates, your performance certificate or letter and other documents which can make you stand out.

Create a document listing all your capabilities, interests, skills and other basic information and transform it into a form of resume through which you’ll be doing an internship during the stay related to your degree that will help you further.
You must have above average grades in order to get into your desired institute and degree program.
The processing and submission part is very different. It is better if you give yourself some time and consult with our team before walking straight into it.

h3: Global Group of Education Cookies Policy

content: This is the privacy policy for the Global Group of Education and the services delivered through this and other sites owned by the Global Group of Education. This Privacy Policy defines how we handle the personal data received from the applicants when they visit the Global Group of Education website. Please read this Policy carefully, because by using or visiting the Global Group of Education website and services, you agree to our terms and conditions. This Privacy Policy relates only to the Global Group of Education website. With time, we can revise this Privacy Policy and will notify our applicants of any possible changes by publishing a notice on our website. If you notice any publishing notice, please re-check our Privacy Policy before continuing to use our website. The revisit to our website after the changes means that you have agreed to our new terms.

We collect your personal information when you visit our website and ask for information about our services and other general information. We can also gather data when you submit an online application for your admissions, or when you sign up for our newsletter service. In order to process your required inquiries, we can collect your full name, phone number, email, and postal addresses. To process enrolments, we can ask for your nationality, date of birth, education history, copy of passport, immigration history, and even ID card. We can also utilize your email and postal address to send information about any further updates on your application, marketing communication, special offers, and other products or services similar to those you agree to enroll or enquired about from us. pages.meta_description: Global group of education provides the opportunity to polish your expertise from the beautiful campus of Chichester with highly talented teachers.
content: Chichester University is situated in beautiful West Sussex County. Our heritage was from the 19th century when Bishop Otter College was founded in 1839. Previous to this, Chichester was a teaching college before it converted into a university. The University has two campuses: One is the Bishop Otter Campus in Chichester, a 10-minute walk from the centre of the city and the other is Bognor Regis Campus situated 915 steps from a wonderful beach. Both of these campuses have outstanding public commute services. These campuses are historic and historic with technologically advanced structures, all set in exquisitely tended gardens.

Every year our students work together with our faculty to perform research and to contribute to the evolving worldwide. In the most recent assessment conducted by the government of university research, REF (Research Excellence Framework), the University has been ranked 90% of their research as the nationally leading, and 15% ranked as the world-leading. In 2013 the University earned the Sunday Times Best University for Student Retention, meaning that few students opted out of their Chichester and Bognor Regis courses. The University also scores well in social studies education, international studies, performing arts, and athletics. 89.7 per cent of the entire study submission by the University was rated as globally renowned in the 2014 Research Excellence Framework, with 15 per cent of the submissions being listed as 'world-leading.'

Chichester University has locations in Chichester and Bognor Regis, in south-east England's West Sussex. Chichester is a university town and home to a variety of historic buildings and is popular in nearby South Downs with outdoor pursuits. The historic seaside resort town of Bognor Regis is very popular with visitors, featuring pleasant beaches and many small villages nearby.

Throughout the Second World War, the campus of the University of Chichester played a vital role in the D-Day invasion; one of the present teaching rooms was used in 1942 as a control room for 56 RAF squadrons stationed during the Normandy airborne invasion.

Chichester University is situated in beautiful West Sussex County. Our heritage was from the 19th century when Bishop Otter College was founded in 1839. Previous to this, Chichester was a teaching college before it converted into a university. The University has two campuses: One is the Bishop Otter Campus in Chichester, a 10-minute walk from the centre of the city and the other is Bognor Regis Campus situated 915 steps from a wonderful beach. Both of these campuses have outstanding public commute services. These campuses are historic and historic with technologically advanced structures, all set in exquisitely tended gardens.

Every year our students work together with our faculty to perform research and to contribute to the evolving worldwide. In the most recent assessment conducted by the government of university research, REF (Research Excellence Framework), the University has been ranked 90% of their research as the nationally leading, and 15% ranked as the world-leading. In 2013 the University earned the Sunday Times Best University for Student Retention, meaning that few students opted out of their Chichester and Bognor Regis courses. The University also scores well in social studies education, international studies, performing arts, and athletics. 89.7 per cent of the entire study submission by the University was rated as globally renowned in the 2014 Research Excellence Framework, with 15 per cent of the submissions being listed as 'world-leading.'

Chichester University has locations in Chichester and Bognor Regis, in south-east England's West Sussex. Chichester is a university town and home to a variety of historic buildings and is popular in nearby South Downs with outdoor pursuits. The historic seaside resort town of Bognor Regis is very popular with visitors, featuring pleasant beaches and many small villages nearby.

Throughout the Second World War, the campus of the University of Chichester played a vital role in the D-Day invasion; one of the present teaching rooms was used in 1942 as a control room for 56 RAF squadrons stationed during the Normandy airborne invasion.

pages.meta_description: If you wish to advance in your current field of work or start a new career, Bucks New University can help you achieve your goals.
content: Bucks New University currently has more than 8,000 students registered and has continued to expand since gaining university status in 2007. Bucks New University was originally established in 1893 as the School of Science and Art and is known for offering many specific courses such as the award-winning Air Transport with Commercial Pilot Training. Most undergraduate and postgraduate students studied at the main campus in High Wycombe, whereas a smaller campus in Uxbridge held classes for the Faculty of Medicine and Nursing.

This New University has a rich 125-year history and offers high-quality, job-focused degree programs in a wide range of areas of study, from pilot training to industry, and nursing and wellness to fashion, design, and creativeness. Bucks New University received a 2018 Teaching Excellence System (TEF) Silver Award representing its inclusive learning environment for its students with small classes, highly engaging teaching, and career-related oriented studies. Yet at Bucks learning isn't just about graduation. It's about jumping into new worlds, discovering new interests and sharing them, making new friends, and becoming a member of a multicultural culture. According to the Times University Guide 2020, Bucks New University stands 113th in the ranking whereas, as per Guardian University Guide 2020, it is in 120th place. The Huffington Post ranked Bucks New University 12th in the UK in a survey of innovative universities and was also included in The Daily Telegraph's ranking of the best 14 innovative universities in the UK. Bucks New University has also received awards for its pilot training and managing the music industry.
Noel Fielding, a comedian, and Great British Bake-Off judge, once studied at Bucks New University. He took courses in graphic design and advertising.
Noel Fielding and Dave Brown – Comedians Naomi Riches -  Paralympic bronze medalist Boo Ritson – Artist Tony Ball -  Founder of Show and Event Security Mark Hamilton - Managing Director of G4S Events

High Wycombe is the second largest town in Buckinghamshire, situated roughly halfway between London and Oxford. It is not only an industrial hub but also a marketplace, as demonstrated by the bustling stalls that crowd the high street almost three days a week–a tradition that stretches back to the 12th century. The city has a new shopping mall, a leisure center, an artificial ski center, and an entertaining nightlife to match the students ' diverse tastes and interests. London is only a 40-minute train ride away, with easy access to both Heathrow with Gatwick airports. Nursing Bucks News students are based in Uxbridge, which is part of the London Underground network.

pages.meta_description: Select a postgraduate course at the University of Surrey as we offer a variety of masters program, which also includes placement opportunities.
content: The University of Surrey is a regional university situated in the south-eastern England city of Guildford. The university has excellent links to London, only a 35-minute train ride away. Listed in the Times & Sunday Times University Guide as' University of the Year' for 2016, there are about 16,000 students from over 140 different countries. In the university, there are three faculties: the Faculty of Engineering and Physical Sciences, the Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences, and the Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences, offering a both undergraduate and postgraduate degrees. The Manor Park site is only a 20-minute walk away, home to further student housing, the School of Veterinary Medicine, and the £ 36M worth Surrey Sports Complex. Surrey was recognized as an' outstanding' organization after it was awarded a coveted Gold Medal in the first-ever organized Teaching Excellence Framework, a testament to the passion for empowering and training students for a promising future. The University creates highly employable graduates with courses designed to offer the required experience and skills to excel in the professional world. We prepare students for the job market, and as part of their undergraduate degree, the majority of our students take up a Technical Training placement. The University of Surrey ranked 32nd in Times University Guide, whereas this position elevates to 26th in the Guardian University Guide 2020. According to the QS World University Rankings 2020, the University of Surrey is on the 274th position. From the Research Excellence Framework for 2014, 78% of the research results of the University were listed either' world-leading' or' internationally outstanding.' Surrey ranked among the top quartile for Electronics Engineering, Biomedical Sciences, and Hospitality and Tourism in all UK universities, and in the top 20 for Economics and Sociology

From high-speed broadband to supermarket scanner, day-to-day life wouldn't be the same without the challenged quantum well laser–first suggested by Surrey University's Professor Alf Adams. Information can now be transmitted at the speed of light by setting out to overcome the drawbacks of laser technology.

Sir Alec Issigonis – Inventor of the Mini Robert Earl – creator of the Planet Hollywood Chain Alan Parker – Chairman of Mothercare Neil Chapman – senior vice president of Exxon Mobil. Sir David Varney – first executive chairman of HM Revenue and Customs.

The main campus of the University of Surrey is located on Stag Hill, near Guildford city center and located close to Guildford Cathedral. A second campus is located at a short distance from Manor Park, and has been developed to develop campus buildings, existing lodging, and sports facilities. London is an hour away by train, with quick access to both airports in Gatwick and Heathrow. The landscaped grounds surrounding the main campus are a protected area of exceptional natural beauty and include country pubs and famous landmarks like Box Hill, as well as rural acres for walking or cycling.

pages.meta_description: Postgraduate Adult Nursing is a very competitive study field, and it is necessary not only to demonstrate academic excellence when applying but also to have a passion for such a challenging task.

h3: Introduction Adult nursing Course BSc for Postgraduate

content: The overall aim of this program is to provide our students with all the skills, knowledge and attributes needed to meet the challenges of what comes into the professional life of a nurse in the continuously changing healthcare needs and to flourish in the modern health Service. The degree offers lifelong learning and career opportunities for the students as well as a strong emphasis on leadership in nursing. Alongside practical experience, you will gain important theoretical knowledge. The cohorts are limited, and this aids in ensuring that our students receive the resources they need to get the most out of the program. Throughout the years of studies, you will be equipped with extensive clinical experience in different settings, like clinics, hospital wards, critical care, community settings, and palliative care.

Nursing is a very competitive study field, and it is necessary not only to demonstrate academic excellence when applying but also to have a passion for such a challenging task. In high-pressure environments, students must have excellent literacy and numeracy skills, be great communicators and be able to function as part of a team. International Baccalaureate Requirement: Minimum 30 points A-level Requirement: ABB Motivational letter IELTS requirement: 7.0 overall with a minimum of 6.0 bands in each module.

Nursing is a very competitive study field and it is necessary not only to demonstrate academic excellence when applying but also to have the passion to play such a challenging task. In high-pressure environments, students must have excellent literacy and numeracy skills, be great communicators and be able to function as part of a team. International Baccalaureate Requirement: Minimum 30 points A-level Requirement: ABB

Based on the institution and type of course, fees vary depending on different factors—generally, the tuition fees for an international undergraduate degree is approximately £ 20,000 Remember that tuition fees are often subject to change due to the internal policies of the universities and the country's inflation.

International students with a UK student visa are expected to have a minimum of £1014 in the bank for every month they expect to remain in the country, or the annual of £ 12180. Studying in London is considerably more costly at £ 1,265 a month, than £ 15,180 a year. Most students with health-care courses may need funding. The government is working to raise extra funding to assist with tuition and transportation expenses for healthcare graduates. Students can apply for grants which need not be repaid. Such grants help with the cost of tuition, or commuting costs for placements. Any disabled student can also qualify for additional grant funding.

h3: Introduction to undergraduate course Ancient History

content: The BA Degree for Ancient History explores a wide range of diverse eras, cultures, and countries. You can choose from the topics which suit your area of interest – from the early period of Greece to Rome and beyond that, the influence of Classics on contemporary history and current affairs. The course also covers a wide geographical area, from the Black Sea to Roman Britain, Egypt, Persia, and North Africa. While focusing on historical modules, you will also get the opportunity to learn Greek and/or Latin and study areas of art, literature, and philosophy.

The degree provides you with arduous training experience, thus producing graduates with an extraordinary breadth of knowledge. They are suitable for many careers in fields as diverse as heritage management, journalism, law, civil service, business, teaching, IT and tourism. They can also undertake further studies and research degrees and can gain employment in major museums and universities locally, and internationally. Graduates can value their bachelor's degree through analytic, research and communication skills that they developed throughout their studies. They can utilize their degree in the following areas of the profession: 1.    Heritage manager 2.    Gallery/museum manager 3.    Archivist 4.    Academic researcher 5.    Historic building inspector 6.    Conversation officer 7.    Museum education officer The average salary of a historian can range from £20,000 annually.

The fees may vary depending on the course and institution generally; the tuition fees for an international BA full-time degree is £19,000 per annum. All entry fees will be annually reviewed and can be subjected as an increase in the fee are also likely to rise (fees are usually set for international students, for the period of the entry year). International students will be required to pay a deposit of £1,000 on their tuition fees before a certificate of acceptance for studies is provided. This fee will only be refunded if permission to immigrate is rejected.

h3: Introduction to Foundation Course  Anthropology for undergraduate (BA Hons)

content: Anthropology is the study of human societies and social sciences. It teaches us the differences between people from all over the world and what we can learn from their lives. A degree in Anthropology builds your skills and knowledge on diverse cultural backgrounds and the way of life of other people and the structuring of society. Study areas such as literature, linguistics, and history are heavily involved in creating theories and lines of the reason that will help a student understand the broad range of ways people around the world live in. The skills and knowledge with which you are going to graduate will help you evaluate the organization and social life so you can think outside the box. Anthropology modules include economics and money, power and politics, environmental impact, faith, health, race and cross-cultural efficiency. Knowledge in cultural studies, geography, languages and internationally handled relations will help formulate a student for an anthropology degree. Anthropology courses include fully equipped modern facilities, access to archaeological artefacts, researchers with a wide range of experience, research elements under strict examination to demonstrate cutting-edge scientific achievements and opportunity to contribute your knowledge to the job market.

The exclusive set of skills that an Anthropology degree ensures that students pursue careers in science, education, media, policy, and non-profit organizations. Their average salary starts from £17,063 for non-professional and £20,000 for professionals individuals.

The department is a highly respected centre of excellence in teaching and research by academics and employers, which also represents the high interest of prospective students of different nationalities. Entry requirements for Anthropology programmes can vary depending on the university and the course you want to join. If you are applying for a degree in Anthropology, you do not need to have previous education in the following, but the grades also play a substantial role in your intended field of study. International Baccalaureate Requirement: Minimum 34 points A-level Requirement: ABB Motivational letter

Based on the institution and type of course, you plan to join, fees vary depending on different factors—generally, the tuition fees for an international Anthropology undergraduate degree range from    £17,000 to £ 30,000. For postgraduate, tuition fees can range between £ 18,000 and £ 26,000. Nonetheless, studying certain master's degrees can bear a few additional costs that you have to pay yourself. Remember that tuition fees are often subject to change due to the internal policies of the universities and the country's inflation. Universities offering the course

pages.title: Architecture Postgraduate- Study in UK – Global Group of Education
pages.meta_description: Architecture Postgraduate courses at UK universities concentrate on the subject's technology, design, cultural and historical aspects, and lectures will be based on history and theory.

h3: Introduction to Postgraduate courses for Architecture

content: Architecture courses at UK universities concentrate on the subject's technology, design, cultural and historical aspects, and lectures will be based on history and theory; it will be held alongside 3D and art design. It offers students the best approach to learning about any part of their career. Becoming a fully qualified architect takes a period of seven years, including five years of study with two years of technical training and practical practice before you appear in the final exams. After the initial undergraduate degree of 3-year, graduates will affiliates with RIBA, the Royal College of British Architects, before enrolling in a BArch, Diploma, or March degree. For prospective students to become architects, it takes patience, hard work, and commitment, but the rewards are massive.

Graduates will find positions in architectural design, engineering and building, preservation, and urban planning after completing the seven years of study needed to become a registered architect. They can find career paths in one of the following areas: •    Building architectural designers •    Structural architects •    Building planners •    Building architects •    Building designers Their average salary can start from £20,000 for professionals and £16,640 for non-professional per annum.

English, mathematics, and art and design are all prerequisite subjects to learn before applying to an architecture program, and you should also know the basics of freehand drawing and skill in designing and creating 3D work is also needed. A portfolio of research is needed to be considered for admission at several Universities in the UK. Entry requirements can vary depending on the university and the course you want to opt for. Here are some other requirements needed: International Baccalaureate Requirement: Minimum 32 points A-level Requirement: AAB with skills of science, art and writing ability IELTS requirement: 6.5 overall with a minimum of 6.0 bands in each module TOEFL requirement: 92 points overall with a minimum of 22 in reading, 21 in listening, 23 in speaking, and 23 in writing.

The fees may vary conditional to the course and institution; the tuition fees for a full-time international degree is £21,200 per annum. All entry fees will be annually reviewed and can be subjected as an increase in the fee are also likely to rise (fees are usually set for international students, for the period of the entry year). International students will be required to pay a deposit of £1,000 on their tuition fees before a certificate of acceptance for studies is provided. This fee will only be refunded if permission to immigrate is rejected.

h3: Introduction to Foundation courses for Architecture

content: Architecture courses at UK universities concentrate on the subject's technology, design, cultural and historical aspects, and lectures will be based on history and theory; it will be held alongside 3D and art design. It offers students the best approach to learning about any part of their career. Becoming a fully qualified architect takes a period of seven years, including five years of study with two years of technical training and practical practice before you appear in the final exams. After the initial undergraduate degree of 3-year, graduates will affiliates with RIBA, the Royal College of British Architects, before enrolling in a BArch, Diploma, or March degree. For prospective students to become architects, it takes patience, hard work, and commitment, but the rewards are massive.

Graduates will find positions in architectural design, engineering and building, preservation, and urban planning after completing the seven years of study needed to become a registered architect. They can find career paths in one of the following areas: •    Building architectural designers •    Structural architects •    Building planners •    Building architects •    Building designers Their average salary can start from £20,000 for professionals and £16,640 for non-professional per annum.

English, mathematics, and art and design are all prerequisite subjects to learn before applying to an architecture program, and you should also know the basics of freehand drawing and skill in designing and creating 3D work is also needed. A portfolio of research is needed to be considered for admission at several Universities in the UK. Entry requirements can vary depending on the university and the course you want to opt for. Here are some other requirements needed: International Baccalaureate Requirement: Minimum 32 points A-level Requirement: AAB with skills of science, art and writing ability IELTS requirement: 6.5 overall with a minimum of 6.0 bands in each module TOEFL requirement: 92 points overall with a minimum of 22 in reading, 21 in listening, 23 in speaking, and 23 in writing.

The fees may vary conditional to the course and institution; the tuition fees for a full-time international degree is £21,200 per annum. All entry fees will be annually reviewed and can be subjected as an increase in the fee are also likely to rise (fees are usually set for international students, for the period of the entry year). content: International students who want to apply for arts and design programs will have to decide on which aspect of the course they want to opt, and the selection of the right university comes next. Every art school has various tools and skills that help you learn. Studio-based work is a fundamental of all programs, with students specializing in painting, sculpture, photography, and digital media. Universities often invite professional critics and artists to share their views and opinion with students whose work have left a mark in the public presentation in the final year student’s work.

Art students can take on with their career in very diverse fields. Some of them include graphic designing, painting, interior designing, illustration, and website design. Their work can expand to the multimedia industry, magazines, and advertisements, Galleries and museums, Fashion and the film industry, etc. Their average salary can start from £19,000 for professionals and £15,808 for non-professional individuals.

Most courses do not define which pre-requisite subjects to study in school, but certain schools demand achievement in an art-related course. It is recommended that you study art history and a must-have a portfolio to represent. International Baccalaureate Requirement: Minimum 34 points A-level Requirement: ABB and work Portfolio IELTS requirement: 6.5 overall with a minimum of 6.0 bands in each module
Specialization in Art degrees can generally be divided into two categories:
fine art, with many other fields available.

Many universities offer also combine art history and fine arts programs, which may be ideal for you if your approach to the subject is in the same interest. A wide variety of specialized art courses are found in specialist art schools.

pages.title: Arts French Undergraduate- Study in UK – Global Group of Education
pages.meta_description: Studying Undergraduate French and History of Art allows us to understand the world we now live in and to shed light on the past.

h3: Introduction to the undergraduate course for Art French

content: French is a popular language throughout the world. Francophone art and philosophy played a central role in the development of our modern society. Studying French and History of Art allows us to understand the world we now live in and to shed light on the past. French and Francophone Studies, as a major subject area, will give you a broad range of courses from the Middle Ages to the 21st century, including professional options taught by leading specialists in their profession. These include several French culture courses–their literature, art, and cinema, but also their political history and philosophical ideas. History of Art will introduce you to the art from various ages and cultures outside the Francophone world. You will learn how the works of art have been made, explore their true meaning, and discover the forms in which they have interpreted.

Arts and humanities research includes an interpretation of human behaviors in a number of cultural contexts and under very specific historical circumstances. Combined with training in critical thinking and communication, the scope of research and the variety of cultural texts and objects studied to make this degree applicable to a wide range of professions, including: 1.    Education 2.    Public administration, civil service, local government, social services, and art institutions 3.    Banking, business, and retail 4.    Charities and campaigning 5.    Advertising, creative industries, journalism, and public relations 6.    Legal workEntry Requirement The department is a highly respected and renowned center of excellence in teaching and research by academics, which also represents the great interest of prospective students of different nationalities. Entry requirements for MA in Art French can vary depending on the university and the course you want to join. If you are applying for this degree, you do not need to have previous education in the following, but the grades also play a substantial role in your intended field of study. Entry requirements can vary depending on the university and the course you want to opt for. Here are some other requirements needed: International Baccalaureate Requirement: Minimum 34 points A-level Requirement: AAB with skills of science, art and writing ability IELTS requirement: 6.5 overall with a minimum of 6.0 bands in each module

The fees may vary conditional to the course and institution; the tuition fees for a full-time international degree is £19,800 per annum. Please note that in subsequent years of study, the International tuition fee is subject to annual changes in compliance with the university terms and conditions. International students will be expected to pay a £ 1,000 deposit on their tuition fees before an acceptance certificate awarded. The fee can only be refunded if you are refused permission to immigrate.
UK universities are well known for making higher education access easier for even foreign students. They offer a range of scholarships to help students from all backgrounds; talented and needy.

h3: Introduction to Foundation Course for Art French

content: French is a popular language throughout the world. Francophone art and philosophy played a central role in the development of our modern society. Studying French and History of Art allows us to understand the world we now live in and to shed light on the past. French and Francophone Studies, as a major subject area, will give you a broad range of courses from the Middle Ages to the 21st century, including professional options taught by leading specialists in their profession. These include several French culture courses–their literature, art, and cinema, but also their political history and philosophical ideas. History of Art will introduce you to the art from various ages and cultures outside the Francophone world. You will learn how the works of art have been made, explore their true meaning, and discover the forms in which they have interpreted.

Arts and humanities research includes an interpretation of human behaviors in a number of cultural contexts and under very specific historical circumstances. Combined with training in critical thinking and communication, the scope of research and the variety of cultural texts and objects studied to make this degree applicable to a wide range of professions, including: 1.    Education 2.    Public administration, civil service, local government, social services, and art institutions 3.    Banking, business, and retail 4.    Charities and campaigning 5.    Advertising, creative industries, journalism, and public relations 6.    Legal workEntry Requirement The department is a highly respected and renowned center of excellence in teaching and research by academics, which also represents the great interest of prospective students of different nationalities. content: Philosophical learning is valued in just about any industry. It strengthens the persuasion power, problem-solving skills, critical thinking, and communication skills. A study shows that these abilities are in great demand in many careers today that require individuals who can stand back and scrutinize with an open mind. Trips to museums and art galleries help the students produce inspire thoughts about how art is shown and received. By taking part in public art commissions and other activities, you'll gain professional experience. The teaching staff are all internationally renowned artists, curators, and scholars, and will promote frequent exhibits and open debate.

Graduates of Philosophy are working in such varied fields like administration, business development, art and design, community and social services, education, consultancy, entrepreneurship, human resources, healthcare, IT, management, media and many research projects. The average annual salary of a philosopher is £32,500, which can vary depending on the job description.
International Baccalaureate Requirement: Minimum 34 points
A-level Requirement: BBB

Candidates must have studied at least one of the following subjects in their A-levels: Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Studies, Government and Politics, Development Studies, Mathematics, Economic and Social History, Sociology, Anthropology, Philosophy, English language, Religious Studies, English Literature, History, Geography, Classical Civilisation, Archaeology, World Development, Biology, Communication Studies, Environmental Studies, World Development, Chemistry, Modern languages, Physics.
IELTS requirement: 6.5 bands overall with a minimum of 6.0 bands in each module

The Visas and Immigration accommodates international applicant and the EU to show proof of a minimum level of English language proficiency in order to receive a UK visa (Tier 4 visa) for undergraduate or even postgraduate study. This level is referred to as the level of' B2.' In addition, individual institute can request specific levels of English language proficiency needed for their academic courses. Those specifications are likely to be higher than the B2 standard in most cases.
TOEFL requirement: 92 points overall with a minimum of 22 in reading, 21 in listening, 23 in speaking and 23 in writing.

Eligible students are given scholarships and bursaries. About one-third of all our UK undergraduate students will receive grants of up to £ 2,000 per annum, in addition to the government grant program.

Typically, all students should be able to complete their study program without incurring extra study costs beyond the tuition fee for that course. pages.meta_description: Biological Sciences would benefit those who are interested in studying living organisms, whether human or other animals, plants or bacteria.
content: This wide-ranging subject explores living organisms but enables you to select research topics according to your interests. For example, options range from disease processes, molecular immune system research, and physiological processes, and may include global-scale environmental, ecology, and biodiversity analysis.

Biological Sciences would benefit those who are interested in studying living organisms, whether human or other animals, plants or bacteria because you can choose the modules best suited to your interests; diagnosing and curing disease for conservation and administration of biological resources.

The versatility of this degree scheme is the characteristic feature; graduates can get a splendid opportunity to choose from the entire teaching portfolio provided to create a specific degree that represents their interests.

Life Sciences graduates are in great demand in public sector research agencies, the National Health Service, government departments, the Environment Agency and forensic science. The commercial sectors which actively recruit Life Sciences graduates include the food, pharmaceutical, water, biotechnology, and agricultural industries. Life scientists are also increasingly demanding to contribute to public comprehension of science as journalists and liaison officers, despite the environmental and ethical concerns emerging, for example, from advances in molecular biology and biotechnology.

Most courses do not define pre-requisite subjects that are compulsory to study in school, but certain schools demand high achievement in their school. In certain institutes pre-requisite subject may include biology, physics, mathematics, and chemistry.
Typical International Baccalaureate requirements: Minimum 38 points Typical A-levels requirements: ABB with outstanding grades in physics, mathematics, biology and chemistry.

Students will study each part of business areas, like marketing, finance, administration, and human resources. Many Business and Management courses offer job placements with globally recognized organizations, enabling the students to experience firsthand what this profession offers.

Most Business and Management programs have a shared course of study in the first year before students can choose courses in the second year of study. Once you complete the degree, vital skills in finance, market knowledge, strategy and data, and management, will help you escalate in your career.
Business programs are offered in more than 120 universities in the United Kingdom and are the largest undergraduate recruiter in the UK, with more than 60,000 students enrolling in the courses.

Business and management is a broad-ranging degree that covers many fields, and there are a wide range of career paths that a graduate may take after completing their studies. Students will have multiple career paths and will be able to explore positions in advertising, finance, accounting, general management, overseeing human resources and marketing.

While pursuing a graduate degree in Business Administration, you will have the opportunity to acquire skills that are very useful in offering services, managing the firm's health, analyzing performance data, keeping workers engaged, maintaining high productivity and making impactful business decisions that drive outcomes.

pages.meta_description: Advanced chemical engineering is concerned with groundbreaking new and valuable techniques and materials, such as nanotech, fuel cells, and biomedical engineering.
content: The curriculum requires students to pursue advanced chemistry studies in conjunction with suitable background studies in basic sciences, mathematics and computational techniques. Such courses aim to provide professional tech knowledge. Students will have the ability to go into the field and discuss the problems that chemical and environmental engineers cater regularly. All universities offering chemical engineering have professional labs that provide the best hand-in experience available. Teaching staffs are sector-proven experts and specialists in their profession, while skills will be developed, such as project planning, communication, and advanced problem-solving. Chemistry is a topic that is continually changing and challenges the limits of what is possible in engineering, science and medicine. Whether you're studying human life biology, collaborating with scientists or having an effect on breakthrough technologies, a degree in Chemical engineering will help you affect the world we live in.

As a chemical engineer, you will be responsible for designing and creating a diverse product portfolio. Your research should concentrate on modifying a substance's chemical, biochemical, and physical condition to make it something different, like producing plastic from oil. You will need to understand how to turn raw materials into the appropriate goods while considering health, safety and cost concerns. You can work in diverse fields, including:

Advanced chemical engineering is concerned with groundbreaking new and valuable techniques and materials, such as nanotech, fuel cells and biomedical engineering. The average annual salary of a chemical engineer ranging from £22,000 to £60,500, which can vary depending on the job description.
International Baccalaureate Requirement: Minimum 34 points
A-level Requirement: ABB(mathematics and chemistry subjects included)
IELTS requirement: 6.5 bands overall with a minimum of 6.0 bands in each module
TOEFL requirement: 92 points overall with a minimum of 22 in reading, 21 in listening, 23 in speaking and 23 in writing.
Master degree in Chemical Engineering can be perused in the following four major fields:
MSc in Advanced Chemical Engineering
MSc in Advanced Chemical Engineering with process systems Engineering
MSc in Advanced Chemical Engineering with Biotechnology
MSc in Advanced Chemical Engineering with Structured Product Engineering

The Advanced Chemical Engineering (ACE) course helps students to pursue advanced studies in chemical engineering paired with basic background studies in mathematics, sciences, and computing techniques, while the specialized MSc like BIO, PSE or SPE provides an opportunity to explore the area of chemical engineering further.
Here is the list of top art universities that offer Chemical Engineering.

University of Nottingham
Imperil College London
University of Bradford
